inference: CPU only, -ngl 0, 8 threads, context 2048, one parallel sequence, F16 KV cache
primary_hypothesis: On Q4_K_M conflict prompts, mean strict action accuracy with historical evidence first differs from accuracy with randomized evidence first.
primary_outcome: Per-family mean Q4_K_M conflict accuracy with historical-first evidence minus mean accuracy with randomized-first evidence; average across 96 families.

primary_test.test: one-sample t test on family-level differences

primary_uncertainty: 95% t interval and 10,000-replicate family bootstrap percentile interval; bootstrap seed 20261130
secondary_outcomes: overall and condition-specific accuracy and strict validity
invalid_output_policy: Invalid JSON or invalid action counts as incorrect; retain every scheduled response in the analysis.
stopping_and_exclusion: No interim stopping or outcome-based exclusions. Preserve incomplete runs; do not infer the primary result unless both format schedules complete.
